messages:
Lena: Heads-up — prospective customer 'CuraLife' requested a 2-week POC: conversational routing + automated case summaries. They want concrete SLOs, security controls (KMS + VPC), and a burn estimate.
Arjun: What's expected concurrency/peak? that drives Dedicated sizing.
Lena: Steady ~55 reqs/min, short spikes to ~160 reqs/min. Avg convo ~620 tokens. Their target: routing p95 <= 380ms, summary p95 <= 800ms.
Marta: Security note — they require customer KMS, EU-only data, and SIEM export. Can we run Dedicated in eu-west-1 with VPC peering? @Raj
Raj: Yes. Dedicated in eu-west-1 with customer KMS and SIEM forwarding is supported. For POC we can disable persistent KV cache and enable transient sessions.
Lena: Draft acceptance gates:
- Routing accuracy >= 91% on a 400-chat labeled eval set
- Summaries: human agreement >= 85% on 200 samples OR ROUGE-L >= 0.61
- Latency: routing p95 <= 380ms; summarization p95 <= 800ms under normal load
- Cost: target <= $0.016 per 1k input tokens (POC estimate)
- Reliability: fallback to quantized model if primary latency >900ms or error rate >1% sustained for 5m; include "served_by" in responses
Arjun: Sample prompts for Eng-ML eval harness (short):
"System: You are a concise summarizer. Output JSON keys: summary, action_items.
User: 'Summarize the conversation and list next steps for ops.'"
Marta: Data handling confirmation needed: no data persists beyond session unless customer opts in; all stored blobs under KMS; redaction pipeline available.
Raj: Confirmed. We'll also provide an IR contact and scope POC to EU region. deploy-bot: Reserved Dedicated slot (2xA10G) eu-west-1 for 2026-07-05 09:00 UTC -> 2026-07-19 09:00 UTC.
Arjun: Cost quick calc: ~6.8M tokens/day (11k conv/day *620) -> at $0.016/1k = ~$109/day -> ~$1.5k for 14d plus infra. Quantized model could reduce compute by ~20%.
Lena: Runbook owners: I'll draft runbook; Arjun will own eval metrics; Raj owns infra and deploy config. We'll finalize thresholds with CuraLife by EOD tomorrow and push SOW.
Marta: I'll answer security questionnaire and include export-control & residency notes.
Lena: Thanks — plan to run a 3-hour load test on day 2 and switch canary to quantized model if burn is high. :white_check_mark:
